query: Last weekend I took my golden retriever to the new dog park downtown, and he had so much fun chasing a squirrel that he ended up covered in mud and I had to give him three baths when we got home. The next day I tried the new matcha latte at the café on the corner, and they added way too much sugar so I could barely finish it, even though I’d asked for no added sweetener. I also just finished binging that new mystery miniseries everyone’s talking about, and the ending was so unexpected I sat there staring at the screen for ten minutes after the credits rolled. Anyway, I need to exchange an item from my delivered order #W2905754, swap item 3478699712 for item 9844888101, and charge any additional cost to the payment method credit_card_3677959.
